digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Mkua, Mrihi)

teaser.en: Blue-to-mauve flowers with one big petal set this tree apart, though it shares its Digo name with the msasa.
teaser.sw: Maua ya rangi ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu yenye petali moja kubwa huutofautisha mti huu, ingawa unashiriki jina lake la Kidigo na myombo.

summary.en: This *mrihi* is a spreading, smooth-barked tree common on the south coast, with blue to mauve flowers and large woody pods. Its bark is a source of fibre.
summary.sw: *Mrihi* huu ni mti uliotanda wenye gome laini, unaopatikana kwa wingi katika pwani ya kusini, wenye maua ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu na maganda makubwa magumu kama mti. Gome lake ni chanzo cha nyuzi.

about.en: This tree has drooping branches, a spreading crown and smooth bark. Each leaf has two to five pairs of leaflets. Its flowers are blue to mauve, each with one large, showy petal. The pods are large and woody.
about.sw: Mti huu una matawi yanayoinama chini, kilele kilichotanda na gome laini. Kila jani lina jozi mbili hadi tano za vijani. Maua yake ni ya buluu hadi zambarau hafifu, kila moja likiwa na petali moja kubwa inayovutia. Maganda ni makubwa na magumu kama mti.

where.en: It is common on the south coast, especially in *Brachystegia* woodland and lowland forest.
where.sw: Unapatikana kwa wingi katika pwani ya kusini, hasa katika mapori ya *Brachystegia* na misitu ya nyanda za chini.

uses.en: The bark is a source of fibre.
uses.sw: Gome lake ni chanzo cha nyuzi.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mrihi*, the same name it uses for *Brachystegia spiciformis*, the msasa. A second name is *mukwe*; the ICRAF handbook gives *mkua* and *mrihi*. In Swahili it is *mkue*, a name also used for *mkuwa*, *Julbernardia magnistipulata*. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia inatoa jina la Kidigo *mrihi*, jina lile lile inalotumia kwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, yaani myombo. Jina la pili ni *mukwe*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkua* na *mrihi*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mkue*, jina linalotumika pia kwa *mkuwa*, *Julbernardia magnistipulata*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.

reason.en: Brachystegia, which shares the name mrihi

reason.sw: Chanzo kingine cha nyuzi za gome
Gome lake la ndani hutumika kwa kamba
